ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
(2017 Hainan College Entrance Examination) As shown in the figure, the two plates of a parallel-plate capacitor are placed vertically and are connected respectively to the positive and negative terminals of a power supply. A charged small ball is suspended between the two plates by a light insulating string and is in a stationary state. Now keep the right plate fixed and slowly move the left plate to the left. Regarding the magnitude F of the electric field force on the small ball and the magnitude T of the tension in the string, which of the following judgments is correct?
A. F gradually decreases, T gradually decreases
B. F gradually increases, T gradually decreases
C. F gradually decreases, T gradually increases
D. F gradually increases, T gradually increases

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, there are two vertically placed parallel metal plates, labeled “left” and “right”; in the middle there is a small ball suspended by an insulating light string from above, and the two plates are connected to the power supply below. Then reason: The problem statement indicates that the two plates are always respectively connected to the positive and negative terminals of the power supply, so the voltage U across the capacitor remains unchanged. Keeping the right plate fixed and slowly moving the left plate to the left will increase the distance d between the two plates. The electric field inside a parallel-plate capacitor approximately satisfies E=U/d; U is unchanged while d increases, therefore the electric field strength E gradually decreases. The charge q of the small ball is unchanged, and the magnitude of the electric field force is F=|q|E, so F gradually decreases.

method.method_draft: 从图中确认这是竖直放置的平行板电容器，带电小球位于两板之间，左板被向左移动而右板固定；从题干读取两板始终分别与电源正负极相连，因此电容器两端电压保持不变。左板向左缓慢移动使两板间距d增大。对平行板电容器近似有匀强电场E=U/d，因U不变而d增大，所以E逐渐减小。小球电荷量q不变，电场力大小F=|q|E，因此F逐渐减小。
